messages:
maria: Heads-up — noticed a sustained p95 TTFT bump for model=v1 on us-west starting ~10:05 UTC. Dashboard shows tokens/sec dropping concurrently.

alex: seeing that too. Grafana panel `Token SLO · region/model` spiked. link: https://grafana.redwood.local/d/abc123/token-slo?orgId=1&var-region=us-west

infra-bot: ALERT fired: token_slo_ttft_p95 > 300ms (group: inference-us-west) :rotating_light:

maria: quick PromQL I used to validate: ```histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=\"inference\"}[5m])) by (le,model,region))```

alex: and tokens/sec check: ```sum(rate(tokens_produced_total{job=\"inference\"}[1m])) by (model,region)``` — for v1 in us-west it's ~40k t/s vs 120k normal.

tim: could be autoscaler oscillation or networking backpressure. Any concurrent GPU provisioning events?

jordan: we had a rolling scale-down on the dedicated pool 09:58-10:03 UTC for cost testing. Might be too aggressive for warm caches.

maria: that matches. When instances spin up we lose KV cache and TTFT jumps. Need better drilldowns in dashboard to correlate cache miss rate and instance churn.

alex: proposal: add templated drilldown variable `instance_group` + row that overlays `kv_cache_hit_ratio` and `host_restarts` with token-level panels. Example panel queries: ```sum(rate(kv_cache_hits_total[5m])) by (model,region) / sum(rate(kv_cache_requests_total[5m])) by (model,region)``` and ```sum(increase(host_restarts_total[10m])) by (instance_group)```

maria: agree. Also cost angle: compute cost per token on the dashboard so product teams see tradeoffs. PromQL suggestion: ```sum(rate(gpu_cost_usd_total[5m])) / sum(rate(tokens_produced_total[5m]))``` with `model` label.

sre-oncall: alert tuning note — current p95 alert fires too often during controlled experiments. Recommend switch to "for: 10m" and add suppression when `team=experiments`. Also create composite alert: p99_ttft > 1s AND tokens_per_sec < 50% of baseline -> pager.

tim: +1. We should avoid paging on transient cache warmups. Add alert annotation linking to runbook: https://redwood-internal/docs/runbooks/token-slo

infra-bot: added annotation suggestion to alert rule draft PR #421.

alex: action items: 1) I will add the templated drilldown panels and tokens/sec heatmap (ETA today EOD). 2) Maria will add cost-per-token panel and baseline series. 3) Tim will update alert rules to include `for: 10m` and composite condition.

maria: I'll also add a small note on the dashboard explaining expected warmup behaviour and recommended thresholds for experiments.

jordan: for dedicated pools, ops will try a gentler scale policy for the experiment window. We'll monitor effect for 2 cycles.

maria: thanks. If p99 TTFT stays >1s after these changes we escalate to infra incident. For now, keep monitoring and post any odd host-level logs here. :eyes:

sre-oncall: copying to incident channel if it crosses composite pager.

alex: pushed dashboard PR, waiting review. PR: https://git.redwood.dev/dashboards/pulls/87

maria: great — will review in 30m.

tim: FYI saved a quick query to correlate network retransmits: ```sum(rate(node_network_retransmits_total[5m])) by (instance)``` — adding to panel row.

jordan: ops note — increasing min-instances from 2 -> 4 for dedicated-us-west during the experiment window to reduce warmups. Will report back.

maria: closing loop — if anyone sees sustained tokens/sec < 60k for v1 after min-instances change, ping and we'll open an incident.

infra-bot: INFO: deployment scale policy change applied at 10:28 UTC.

maria: thanks all. Short follow-up tomorrow with aggregated 24h token SLO heatmap and cost delta.
